commonAuthoritySchema.taskExecutionAuthorizedRule: True only for the exact currently authorized G132 control record; task metadata and every later boundary remain false until separate instruction and committed predecessor.

decisionEligibility.prerequisite: Any authenticated committed B132-1 pass or fail may reach O132-0 after a new operator instruction.

digestFraming.framing: Exact canonical UTF-8 file bytes including exactly one final LF.
literal domain UTF-8 including NUL, then for each of seven ordered members: POSIX filename UTF-8 || NUL || exact member bytes || NUL
Exact candidate-manifest bytes including final LF; manifest excludes itself.
Exact frozen-semantic-target bytes including final LF; target binds candidate manifest and does not hash itself.
literal domain UTF-8 including NUL || canonical report JSON without final LF and without the declared stored digest field
literal domain UTF-8 including NUL || canonical compact JSON encoding of exactly one JSON value without final LF

retryRules.afterCommit: Immutable; create a new additive attempt/task/commit.
retryRules.beforeCommit: Only exact new attempt task-local files may be corrected or individually removed; no broad clean/reset/stash.
retryRules.failedAssurance: May proceed only to reject/stop or a separately authorized additive attempt; never repair A132-1.

roleSeparation.assurance: Future fresh reviewer reads one exact immutable A132-1 subject and performs no repair.
roleSeparation.author: Future A132 author encodes the fixed G132 mapping and candidate evidence only.
roleSeparation.governance: Pins immutable evidence, narrow supersession, topology, inventories, containment, and validation only.
roleSeparation.operator: Future genuine operator records one separately instructed decision only.

terminalBoundary: STOP after O132-1. Acceptance authorizes semantic-contract authority only for a separately governed future technical campaign.
